edges: Jack London was involved in a divorce with Bessie, and Strunsky was named as the co-respondent.
Biographers agree that the relationship between Jack London and Strunsky was platonic.

multi_hop_neighbors.edge: Anna Strunsky was named as the co-respondent in Jack London's divorce from his first wife, Bessie.
Biographers have shown varying levels of interest in The Kempton-Wace Letters in relation to Jack London's life and ideas.
